chunks.text: Hello everyone, Assalamualaikum, welcome back to my channel Indian Kitchen Asma Today I am going to make Sattu Ladoo It is very healthy and has a lot of protein If you like my recipe, please like and subscribe to my channel These are the ingredients for Sattu Ladoo You can see ghee in a bowl I am using jaggery powder, you can use any powder of your choice I am adding cardamom, dry fruits, etc. You can add any dry fruit of your choice I am adding ghee in a wok and I am frying dry fruits So that it gets crunch I am adding ghee in a wok I am adding ghee in a wok It is melting, so I am adding the powder You can use roasted chickpeas and grind it I am adding ghee in a wok I am adding roasted chickpeas and grind it You can use gram flour as well, but it takes longer to roast I am adding cardamom powder and I am roasting it It will give a nice colour and flavour I am adding dry fruits and I am roasting it I am adding jaggery powder You can use sugar or jaggery powder instead I am mixing it well I am turning off the gas and I am mixing it in the same heat I have already uploaded a video of Sattu Paratha, you can watch it on my channel I am mixing it well I will give it a shape when it cools down I am giving it a shape when it cools down I am giving it a shape when it cools down You can make it big or small as per your choice I am pressing it I am making more laddoos I am adding dry fruits If you like my recipe, please like and subscribe to my channel Thanks for watching
